title: The Unbilled Revenue Leak
subtitle: The company delivered $4.2M in services last quarter that never got invoiced. Why?
learning_objectives: Use AI to reconcile delivery records against billing records to find gaps
Detect systematic billing failures vs. one-off exceptions
Quantify revenue leakage by root cause category
Distinguish contractual write-offs from process failures
deliverable: Revenue leakage report with quantified gaps and recovery plan
